summary_en: Interim and first dividend of ¥4.50 per share, ¥93M total, effective 2026-09-15. Record date 2026-06-30. Marks first dividend distribution following shift in capital allocation policy to balance growth investment with direct shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice of Interim Dividend (Initial Dividend Distribution)
translation_en_brief:
OpenWork Inc. announced on 2026-08-10 an interim and first dividend distribution of ¥4.50 per share, totalling ¥93M, with record date 2026-06-30 and effective date 2026-09-15, sourced from retained earnings.

The company stated that while it has prioritised growth investment for long-term value creation, improved performance and earnings have established a strong financial foundation with stable operating cash flow. The company now intends to maintain high profitability whilst expanding operations, and has revised its capital allocation policy to pursue both continued growth investment and direct shareholder returns.

This initial dividend reflects the company's transition to a balanced capital allocation approach aligned with cost of capital and stock price awareness, informed by business phase progression and financial position. The ¥4.50 per share amount aligns with the most recent dividend forecast announced on 2026-03-17.
